description: This file defines type casting utilities and templates for converting between various numeric and complex types, including handling of special cases and complex type conversions, within the c10 namespace of the PyTorch codebase.

classes.name: needs_real
classes.description: Determines if a type conversion requires extracting the real part when converting from complex to non-complex types.

classes.name: maybe_real
classes.description: Conditionally extracts the real part of a complex number based on a boolean template parameter.

classes.name: maybe_bool
classes.description: Conditionally computes a boolean value from a complex number, avoiding the use of the bool operator for compatibility.

classes.name: static_cast_with_inter_type
classes.description: Performs type casting with specializations for complex and other types, including handling of undefined behavior and special conversions.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a value from one type to another using the static_cast_with_inter_type template.

methods.name: checked_convert
methods.description: Performs type conversion with overflow checking and reports overflow errors.

methods.name: report_overflow
methods.description: Reports an overflow error during type conversion.
